subject: net
title: Subnetting
procedure: Splitting IPv4 networks into subnets (CIDR, VLSM)
promptTemplate: Give an IPv4 network and requirements for the subnets. easy: subnets of equal size. medium: VLSM with 3 subnets. exam: VLSM with 4–5 subnets and transfer networks. Asked for: network address, prefix, broadcast, first/last host per subnet. When checking: each row on its own, check for overlaps and order (largest first).
answerFormat: Table: subnet | network address/prefix | first host | last host | broadcast.
